title: 限量新品关注度高，怎样安排预订和客户体验？
topic: 安排限量新品预订、市场配额和客户体验

source.title: Toyota Yaris GRMN: Marketing Interview and Development Programme
source.section: Toyota Yaris GRMN: Interview with Marketing Manager Tommaso Grassi
source.type: 丰田官方车型项目与市场推广访谈
source.context: Toyota 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
source.author: Tommaso Grassi
paragraphs: 12 INTERVIEW: TOMMASO GRASSI, MARKETING Tommaso Grassi is Toyota Motor Europe’s Marketing Manager re- sponsible for sports cars and has been closely involved in designing and executing the unique marketing programme for the Yaris GRMN. What is the thinking behind bringing the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing brand to Europe? “With TOYOTA GAZOO Racing, Toyota is refining its products and im- proving the skills and engagement of its people through motorsport, which supports our ultimate purpose of making ever-better cars. But the intention is not to limit TOYOTA GAZOO Racing’s influence to com- petition activities; it gives us a great opportunity to link motorsport to our production cars and bring more excitement and passion to our brand. “Yaris is our best-selling model in Europe and now the Yaris WRC is our car competing in the World Rally Championship. What was missing was a link between the two, a role that’s been filled by the Yaris GRMN. We took the opportunity to create a standard production car that re- flects the pinnacle of TOYOTA GAZOO Racing execution, capturing what we are doing in motorsport and making it accessible to our cus- tomers. What were the priorities for the car? “We wanted there to be unique elements to the Yaris GRMN, including limiting production to just 400 units for Europe. It would also have ex- clusive use of the supercharged 1.8-litre engine – unique in its class – and use state-of-the-art components to achieve an excellent power to weight ratio and acceleration.

13 How did the marketing strategy progress, from announcing the car to it going on sale? “There was an instant, positive response from the moment the first sketches were revealed, from the media, the public and our national sales and marketing companies that would be selling the car. The level of attention it received went far beyond our expectations and made our task a lot easier. “We chose the concept of online reservations as it was appropriate for the very limited numbers we were building. It’s a unique product, so we wanted a unique process. The traditional approach is to wait for start of production, then host a dynamic product launch just before putting a car on sale, but because of the high expectations for Yaris GRMN, we opened the reservations process right after the Meet the Engineer event at Nürburgring in July. There was a great response, with most countries selling their allocation in around just 72 hours. “Making it happen presented some challenges, but it struck the right note with customers, we needed to build excitement around the car and this was helped by the very positive media coverage we received. Our national sales and marketing companies have also or- ganised private events for people who have made reservations, giving them the chance to drive the Yaris GRMN on some of Europe’s best rac- ing circuits – Monza, Nürburgring and Silverstone – at an early stage. From a marketing perspective, what have been the important learn- ings from this project? “We have seen how translating the TOYOTA GAZOO Racing philosophy into standard production cars gives us the opportunity to target people that Toyota would not have been able to reach in the past. We see clear future potential for this. Europe is the world’s most competitive car mar- ket, which means plenty of pressure, but also great opportunities ahead.” WE CHOSE THE CONCEPT OF ONLINE RESERVATIONS BECAUSE IT’S A UNIQUE PRODUCT, SO WE WANTED A UNIQUE PROCESS

DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME • Intensive development of vehicle dynamics and performance at a dedicated Toyota facility close to the Nürburgring circuit • Work undertaken by an expert team of European and Japanese technicians, including master drivers who tested the car on the track and on local roads • Project successfully moved from concept to production-ready vehicle in just two years 14
translations: Tommaso Grassi 是丰田欧洲负责跑车业务的市场经理，参与设计并执行 Yaris GRMN 的推广计划。问：把 TOYOTA GAZOO Racing 品牌带到欧洲，背后的考虑是什么？答：丰田通过赛车运动改进产品、提升员工技能，最终目标是造出更好的汽车。品牌影响力不应只停留在赛事中；它也能把赛车运动与量产车型联系起来，为品牌带来更多激情。Yaris 是丰田在欧洲销量最高的车型，Yaris WRC 则参加世界拉力锦标赛；两者之间缺少一个连接点，Yaris GRMN 承担了这一角色。我们希望打造一款量产车，把赛车部门的成果带给消费者。车型的优先考虑是什么？我们希望它有独特配置，包括欧洲限量生产 400 台、使用同级别独有的机械增压 1.8 升发动机，并采用先进部件来实现出色的功率重量比和加速性能。

问：从车型发布到正式销售，推广策略是怎样推进的？答：从公布首批设计草图开始，媒体、公众以及负责销售该车的各国销售和市场团队都立即作出积极反应。关注度远超预期，让我们的工作容易了一些。由于产量非常有限，我们选择了线上预订；这是一款独特产品，因此我们也希望采用独特流程。传统做法是在开始生产后、正式销售前举办产品发布活动。但 Yaris GRMN 的市场期待很高，我们在 7 月于纽博格林举办“与工程师见面”活动后，就立刻开放了预订。市场反响很好，多数国家大约 72 小时内就售完了分配到的配额。执行过程中也有挑战，但这种做法获得了客户认可；正面的媒体报道也帮助我们营造期待。各国销售团队还为已预订客户举办专场活动，让他们提前在蒙扎、纽博格林和银石等欧洲赛道试驾。问：这个项目从营销角度带来了哪些重要经验？答：将 TOYOTA GAZOO Racing 的理念融入量产车，让丰田有机会触达以往难以触及的人群，未来也有明显的发展空间。欧洲是全球竞争最激烈的汽车市场，压力很大，但也蕴含许多机会。
设计与开发计划：在纽博格林赛道附近的丰田专用设施内，集中开发车辆动态性能。项目由欧洲和日本的技术专家团队负责，其中包括在赛道和当地道路上测试车辆的资深驾驶员。项目仅用两年就从概念推进到可量产状态。

source.fullTextEndParagraph: 16 DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME THE YARIS GRMN has been extensively developed in Europe, the world’s most competitive and demanding market for B-segment per- formance hatchbacks. Immediately after the first concept car was completed in 2015, a European-built prototype was shipped to a dedicated Toyota facil- ity close to the legendary Nürburgring race circuit in Germany. Here a select group of specialists from Europe and Japan honed the car’s handling and performance, putting it through rigorous testing both on the notoriously challenging Nordschleife track and on a wide va- riety of public roads in the immediate neighbourhood, from ultra-fast Autobahns to tightly winding mountain routes. Toyota’s belief is that if a car can prove its capabilities in this environment, it can do so any- where in the world. The name GRMN itself declares the special efforts that have been invested in the car, standing for GAZOO Racing tuned by the Meister of Nürburgring. The hugely experienced team working on the car have also been able to draw on the experience gained by TOYOTA GAZOO Racing from its regular participation in endurance races at the circuit. The development programme contained a number of distinct chal- lenges, including a redesign of the exhaust system so that it emerged through the centre of the rear diffuser; management of engine cool- ing; securing excellent durability throughout; and control of vehicle weight.

notes.phrase: limiting production to just 400 units for Europe
notes.meaning: 欧洲市场的产量限制为 400 台。
notes.explain: limiting production… 说明产品供应策略；限量是后续线上预订选择的背景。
notes.example: We are limiting production to 2,000 units this year.

notes.phrase: The level of attention it received went far beyond our expectations
notes.meaning: 产品受到的关注度远远超出团队预期。
notes.explain: go beyond expectations 表示实际关注度高于预估。
notes.example: Customer interest went beyond our expectations.

notes.phrase: Project successfully moved from concept to production-ready vehicle in just two years
notes.meaning: 项目在两年内从概念推进到可量产车型。
notes.explain: production-ready vehicle 指已完成开发、可进入量产的车型。
notes.example: The project moved from concept to a production-ready product in 18 months.

scenario.title: 模拟情境：限量新品首发安排
english: A limited-run product attracts strong interest after its first design reveal.
The initial supply is small, and the usual launch schedule may leave customers waiting without clear information.
Recommend when to open reservations, explain how to manage the allocation, and suggest an early experience for confirmed customers.
chinese: 一款限量新品在首次设计发布后受到广泛关注。
首批供应有限，按常规节奏上市可能让顾客等待，却得不到明确的信息。
请建议何时开放预订、如何安排各市场配额，以及为已确认预订的顾客提供什么提前体验。

firstAttempt.prompt: 限量新品在设计发布后受到广泛关注，但首批供应有限。请建议何时开放预订、如何向各市场说明配额，并为已确认预订的顾客安排一项提前体验。
firstAttempt.sample: Demand has gone far beyond expectations after the design reveal. I’d open reservations after the launch event and publish a clear allocation for each market. We should track how quickly each allocation is taken and keep customers updated on delivery timing. For confirmed customers, we could offer an early product experience while they wait.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先安排开放预订的时点，再把市场配额和后续客户体验说清楚。丰田 Yaris GRMN 的案例展示了限量、开放预订和邀请客户试驾的完整做法。

words.example: Most countries sold their allocation in around 72 hours.
words.translation: 多数国家约 72 小时内售完了各自的配额。
words.note: 指分配给某个市场、团队或客户群体的数量。

words.example: Toyota opened online reservations after the Nürburgring event.
words.translation: 丰田在纽博格林活动后开放了线上预订。
words.note: 在产品正式发售前，reservation 可指登记购买意向或预订名额。

words.collocation: interest / demand goes far beyond expectations
words.example: Interest in the Yaris GRMN went far beyond expectations.
words.translation: 大家对 Yaris GRMN 的关注度远超预期。
words.note: 说明实际反应高于事先预计。

taskPhrases.collocation: interest / demand goes far beyond expectations
taskPhrases.example: Demand for the limited product went far beyond expectations after the design reveal.
taskPhrases.translation: 这款限量产品在设计发布后需求远超预期。

taskPhrases.word: Open reservations after the launch event.
taskPhrases.meaning: 在上市活动后开放预订。
taskPhrases.example: I’d open reservations after the launch event.
taskPhrases.translation: 我会在上市活动后开放预订。

taskPhrases.word: Offer confirmed customers an early experience.
taskPhrases.meaning: 为已确认预订的顾客提供提前体验。
taskPhrases.collocation: offer + customer + an early / private experience
taskPhrases.example: We could offer confirmed customers an early driving experience while they wait.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们可以在等待期间为已确认预订的顾客安排提前试驾。

structure.original: We chose the concept of online reservations as it was appropriate for the very limited numbers we were building.
analysis: We chose…as… 表示选择一种做法，并给出原因。
appropriate for… 说明线上预订与限量供应相匹配。
the very limited numbers we were building 解释预订流程要解决的供需约束。
structure.transfer: After the product preview, we can publish market allocations and give confirmed customers an early demonstration.

rewrite.bad: The car was popular, so Toyota sold out quickly.
rewrite.good: Demand has gone far beyond expectations after the design reveal. I’d open reservations after the launch event and publish a clear allocation for each market. We should track how quickly each allocation is taken and keep customers updated on delivery timing. For confirmed customers, we could offer an early product experience while they wait.
rewrite.translation: 这款产品在设计发布后需求远超预期。我会在上市活动后开放预订，并公布各市场的配额。我们应跟踪各市场配额的售出速度，并持续更新交付时间。等待期间，可以为已确认预订的顾客提供提前体验。
rewrite.pattern: Demand went far beyond expectations after [event]. Open reservations after [launch moment], publish [allocation], and offer confirmed customers [early experience].

cloze.why: beyond expectations 表示超出预期。

cloze.prompt: We should open ______ after the launch event.
cloze.why: open reservations 表示开放预订。

cloze.prompt: We could offer confirmed customers an early ______ while they wait.
cloze.why: experience 可指试驾、预览等客户体验。

dictation.label: 听写 1
dictation.text: The level of attention it received went far beyond our expectations and made our task a lot easier.
dictation.why: 留意 went far beyond 后面的比较对象。

apply.prompt: 由于首批数量有限，我们选择了线上预订。
apply.sample: We chose online reservations because the initial supply was limited.

dictation.label: 听写 2
dictation.text: Most countries sold their allocation in around just 72 hours.
dictation.why: 听清 allocation 以及 in around 72 hours 的时间表达。

apply.prompt: 已确认预订的客户可以提前参加一场产品演示。
apply.sample: Confirmed customers can attend an early product demo.

translationPractice.prompt: 这款限量产品在设计发布后需求远超预期。
translationPractice.answer: Demand for the limited product went far beyond expectations after the design reveal.
translationPractice.why: 用 demand went far beyond expectations 描述需求情况。

translationPractice.prompt: 我会在上市活动后开放预订。
translationPractice.answer: I’d open reservations after the launch event.
translationPractice.why: 用 open reservations 说明预订启动安排。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们可以在等待期间为已确认预订的顾客安排提前试驾。
translationPractice.answer: We could offer confirmed customers an early driving experience while they wait.
translationPractice.why: 提出为已确认预订的顾客提供提前体验。

choice.prompt: 一款限量新品在设计发布后受到关注，但首批供应不多。哪项上市安排更清楚？
options: Open reservations without explaining supply or customer updates.
Open reservations after the launch event, publish each market’s allocation, track reservation pace, and offer confirmed customers an early experience.
Wait until all units are delivered before telling customers when reservations will open.
choice.why: 这项安排交代了预订时点、市场配额、顾客信息和等待期间的体验。

output.prompt: 一款智能音箱将在三个市场上市，首批供应有限，下周还有一场产品体验活动。请给销售团队写一条简短安排：说明预订何时开始、如何公布各市场配额，并为已确认预订的顾客提供什么体验。
output.sample: Let’s open reservations after next week’s product event and publish each market’s confirmed allocation at the same time. We should track reservation pace by market and offer confirmed customers an online product preview while they wait. If demand exceeds supply, we can update delivery estimates before accepting more orders.
check: 提出公布和跟踪市场配额的办法
为已确认预订的顾客安排等待期间的体验

blockers: 人工听审音频，逐条确认与页面文字一致并检查语速、停顿和截断。
真实账号进度保存和生产环境逐期验收。
